# RealDays
> Unique experiences run by the local people who started them. In Victoria, Australia and Bali.

RealDays is a booking site for small, owner-run experience businesses. Being listed and taking bookings is free until 1 May 2027. After that, businesses pay a 12% commission per booking, only on bookings made through RealDays, with card fees and GST included. Businesses get at least 60 days' notice first and can leave whenever they want. No subscription or setup fee.

## Salty Cowboy, Bali
Owner-run horse rescue and riding centre in Bali, run by Simone. 11 experiences: beach and rice field rides, photoshoots, and lessons from grooming to a 3-day Horse Whisperer course. Prices from IDR 1,250,000.
